text: 第五届北斗规模应用国际峰会15日在湖南株洲开幕。中共中央政治局委员、国务院副总理张国清出席开幕式并致辞。 张国清表示，中国愿同各方一道，积极落实四大全球倡议，始终坚持开放融合、协调合作、兼容互补、成果共享，进一步提高北斗技术创新水平，加强北斗与人工智能、卫星互联网等技术融合，持续推进系统迭代升级，推动北斗产业健康有序发展，加速北斗应用提质扩面，完善卫星导航全球治理，让北斗系统更好服务全球、造福人类。（新华社）
text_en: The 5th BeiDou Scale Application International Summit opened on the 15th in Zhuzhou, Hunan Province. Zhang Guoqing, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Vice Premier of the State Council, attended the opening ceremony and delivered a speech. Zhang Guoqing said that China is willing to work with all parties to actively implement the four global initiatives, always adhere to openness and integration, coordination and cooperation, compatibility and complementarity, and sharing of achievements, further improve the level of BeiDou technological innovation, strengthen the integration of BeiDou with AI, satellite internet and other technologies, continue to advance system iteration and upgrading, promote the healthy and orderly development of the BeiDou industry, accelerate the improvement of BeiDou applications in quality and coverage, improve global governance of satellite navigation, and make the BeiDou system better serve the world and benefit humanity. (Xinhua News Agency)
